objectives: Describe the war of the four kings against the five and how Lot was taken.
Explain how Abram won the battle and where victory comes from.
Identify Melchizedek and the tithe Abram paid him.
takeaways: Four Mesopotamian kings warred against five; because Lot dwelt in Sodom he was carried away captive.
Abram armed 318 trained servants, divided them by night and smote four kingdoms: he was a warrior, not the frail figure of the images.
The victory of battle stands not in the multitude of an host; the battle is not yours but God's (2 Chronicles 20:15).
Melchizedek, king of Salem (peace) and priest of the Most High, received tithes from Abram long before the Levitical priesthood.
Abram refused the goods of Sodom, from a thread to a shoelatchet, lest the king say he made Abram rich.
